target.statement: For every finite standard-Borel agent network of arbitrary finite cardinality, every finite interaction hypergraph on it, and every normalized parameter-independent blocking channel satisfying the declared domination, product-factor, gauge-equivariance, smoothness, and integrability hypotheses, construct a typed scale-indexed measure-pair, action, full-interaction, score-tangent, bundle, configuration, and history theory whose exact coarse maps, derivatives, contractions, defects, generalized modes, cocycles, beta data, fixed objects, pullback compatibilities, extended ELBO identities, and exact-versus-projected boundaries satisfy the obligations atomized in the bound claim ledger.
target.quantifiers: For every finite vertex set V_l with no upper bound on |V_l|; every finite standard-Borel product space X_l=product_{i in V_l} X_{l,i}; every finite interaction hypergraph; every probability reference rho_l; every finite positive likelihood measure m_l=exp(-H_l)rho_l; every normalized parameter-independent Markov kernel K_l:X_l rightsquigarrow X_{l+1} admitted by the stated hypotheses; every declared principal G-bundle, pair of associated statistical bundles, compatible scale morphism, DQM score path, full Hoeffding interaction, retained projection, regular configuration manifold, and selected fine history meeting its local assumptions; and every finite composable sequence of such scales.
domains: Finite standard-Borel product networks indexed by arbitrary finite vertex sets with no cardinality ceiling.
Finite positive measure pairs (rho_l,m_l), normalized laws pi_l, and normalized parameter-independent Markov kernels K_l:X_l rightsquigarrow X_{l+1}.
Bounded action charts B_l=L-infinity(pi_l;R), action quotients overline(B_l)=B_l/R1, centered L-p tangents, and score quotients L2(pi_l)/R1.
Full power-set Hoeffding interaction spaces G_l=direct-sum over nonempty A subseteq V_l of L-infinity_{0,A}(nu_{l,A}), with product reference nu_l equivalent to pi_l.
Declared closed retained subspaces G_{l,Q} with bounded idempotent projections Q_l, treated separately from the full interaction spaces.
Principal bundles P_l to C_l with structure group G, associated belief and model statistical bundles, gauge representations, connections, sections, and normalized Markov fiber morphisms.
DQM statistical paths with centered L2 scores; iid Gaussian fixed-law realization with normalized Hermite basis; and finite exact interaction-family tangents.
Smooth regular configuration manifolds Q_l of admissible sections with declared configuration-space Fisher metrics and locally well-posed VFE vector fields.
codomains: Next-scale positive measure pairs, normalized laws, bounded action classes, centered L-p tangents, and score tangents.
Next-scale full Hoeffding interactions, retained projected interactions, and quotient-space truncation residuals.
Next-scale associated statistical bundles and configuration manifolds through separately typed bundle and configuration morphisms.
Reference-space endomorphisms only after declared isomorphisms; otherwise scale-indexed linear maps and cocycles between distinct spaces.
target.regularity: Standard-Borel disintegration with a fixed jointly measurable reverse-kernel version; bounded open L-infinity action chart for nonlinear Frechet derivatives; DQM with finite L2 score for statistical tangents; smooth finite-Fisher statistical families and parameter-independent Markov fiber morphisms for Fisher pullbacks; bounded assembly, extraction, projection, and comparison operators; and smooth regular configuration manifolds with locally existing unique VFE vector fields where histories are compared.
measures: rho_l is a probability measure and m_l=exp(-H_l)rho_l has mass strictly between zero and infinity.
pi_l=m_l/m_l(X_l), rho_{l+1}=rho_l K_l, m_{l+1}=m_l K_l, and pi_{l+1}=pi_l K_l.
The interaction tier uses a covariantly transforming product probability nu_l equivalent to pi_l, so the two laws have identical null sets.
Every probability-family comparison uses a fixed family-level sigma-finite dominating measure; mixed coordinates use one fixed countable atomic support covering the admitted family.
Every likelihood, score, entropy, KL, conditional expectation, and derivative-under-integral expression states support, absolute-continuity, finiteness, domination, and measurable-version hypotheses.
boundary_conditions: Action constants are retained when evidence mass is retained and are quotiented only when mass is deliberately forgotten.
The full Hoeffding normalization uses zero conditional mean in every active coordinate and carries the evidence-mass constant separately.
A singular Gaussian interaction operator is a boundary operator, not a normalized Gaussian density, unless a separately declared pinning, quotient, or mass repair closes the probability layer.
Inference histories remain on regular metric or quotient-metric strata; singular crossings, null intervals, and nonunique flows require separate obligations.
Generated higher-body interactions remain in the exact theory; every truncation carries its declared quotient residual norm.
symmetries: Passive gauge changes on one principal G-bundle with possibly inequivalent belief and model representations.
Componentwise or explicitly tracked permutation actions that preserve the finite product factor structure and push coordinate reference laws covariantly.
Additive action constants, Hoeffding redistribution gauge fixed by hierarchical zero means, and tempered rescalings of generalized-mode sections.
Reference-space and scheme changes only through declared injective isomorphisms with explicit transformation laws.
Orientation-preserving reparameterization of selected inference orbits, kept distinct from scale transformations.
target.equivalence: Equality of measure pairs and laws is measure equality; actions are equal modulo constants only in the explicitly projective tier; interaction coordinates are equal in the hierarchical zero-mean gauge; bundle objects are compared modulo declared passive gauge action only after equivariance and cocycle coherence; generalized-mode exponents are invariant only under the fixed normalization or a proved tempered scale gauge; inference histories are equal only as oriented unparameterized orbits under positive reparameterization.
premises: Each scale object and map is typed before composition; a kernel, bundle morphism, action map, interaction map, score map, and configuration map are not identified by notation.
Each K_l is a normalized parameter-independent positive Markov kernel and admits the stated standard-Borel disintegration.
The nonlinear action theorem is restricted to an open bounded L-infinity chart; extensions to weighted or Orlicz charts require separate uniform moment and differentiability proofs.
The full interaction theorem uses finite product structure, nu_l equivalent to pi_l, all nonempty subsets, and bounded assembly and extraction.
A projected interaction flow is exact only if invariance of the retained subspace is proved; otherwise the residual is retained.
A gauge-independent conclusion requires equivariance, quotient descent, overlap cocycles, and any connection-compatibility square used by the conclusion.
An ordinary spectrum, fixed point, or beta difference is formed only after compatible identification with one normed reference space.
Fisher duration and inference orientation are attached only to a selected regular orbit and are not identified with RG depth or physical time.
modeling_postulates: The selected finite scale diagram and its declared blocking channels are modeling inputs, not consequences of bundle geometry.
Any operational identification of an information-duration coordinate with a physical clock is a separate postulate outside the theorem target.
permitted_theorems: Standard-Borel disintegration and regular-conditional-probability theorems with hypotheses mapped explicitly.
Conditional Jensen inequality, conditional-variance decomposition, and L-p conditional-expectation contraction.
Frechet analyticity of the bounded conditional log-Laplace map with explicit norm bounds.
Finite product Hoeffding or ANOVA decomposition with hierarchical zero-mean normalization.
DQM score pushforward under parameter-independent Markov kernels and Fisher data processing.
Gaussian conditional expectation and completeness of normalized probabilists' Hermite polynomials.
Cocycle and transfer-operator results only after exact source statements and hypothesis mappings are recorded.
Primary-source attribution results only after current source audit; project prose is not external authority.
target.falsification_criterion: One typed admitted finite network, kernel, gauge datum, score path, interaction, projection, or configuration history for which any universal target conjunct fails under all of its recorded assumptions refutes that conjunct; a type mismatch, nonmeasurable object, failed compatibility square, missing generated interaction, norm-dependent contradictory spectrum, nonzero unreported residual, or physical-time identification without a bridge also blocks affirmative release.
target.literature_policy: Use checked primary papers, original theorem sources, or authoritative monographs available in the Research vault or retrievable from arXiv and publisher records through 2026-08-03; record exact theorem statements and hypothesis mappings; English-language sources are sufficient for this bounded remediation search; stop a family when its fingerprint repeats without removing a gap or when its premise violates the contract; do not make worldwide priority or exhaustive-literature claims.
exclusions: Quasilocality, summability, and convergence claims not separately assumed and proved.
Physical time, a global synchronized clock, or identification of RG depth with inference duration.
Blocking-scheme-independent universality classes or universal exponents not separately proved.
Empirical predictions, runtime-code claims, PIFB2, historical five-term objectives, and executable configuration semantics.
Automatic complemented statistical-versus-scaling decompositions, spectral projections, or autonomous semigroups.
Automatic exact closure of a sparse or finite retained interaction ansatz.
